cat > /tmp/tk364_est.py <<'EOF'
import os,sys,collections
roots=["/data/tk0364/outw","/data/tk0364/outw2"]
S=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,set(),set(),0,0])  # chain -> swaps, blocks, txs, bytes, pools
for r in roots:
    for dp,dn,fn in os.walk(r):
        for f in fn:
            if not f.endswith(".csv"): continue
            p=os.path.join(dp,f); rel=os.path.relpath(p,r).split(os.sep)
            ch=rel[0]; ch="bsc" if ch=="bsc-core" else ch
            s=S[ch]; s[3]+=os.path.getsize(p)
            with open(p) as fh:
                next(fh)
                for ln in fh:
                    a=ln.split(",",4)
                    if len(a)<4: continue
                    s[0]+=1; s[1].add(a[0]); s[2].add(a[3])
for ch,s in S.items():
    print(ch,"swaps",s[0],"blocks",len(s[1]),"txs",len(s[2]),"MB",s[3]//10**6)
EOF
